description: A preset klezmer drum sequencer: six instruments, each playing one of eight patterns for the rhythm style chosen

params.text: Each press starts the sequencer and the next press stops it, with the lamp lit while it runs, despite the maker's tooltip naming the two values Start and Stop
Picks the rhythm style: Bulgar #1, Bulgar #2, Araber, Terkisher, Hora/Zhok or In Zibn
Picks which of that instrument's eight patterns plays
Silences that instrument's gate output; the module comes up with all six sounding
Sets the swing applied to the sequence
Sets how long the gates stay high

inputs.text: A voltage rising above 0V starts the sequencer, and the next rise stops it, the same way the button does
Adds to the swing, a fifth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the gate width, a fifth of the knob's travel per volt
The clock the sequence advances on

outputs.text: A pulse each time the sequence returns to its first step
A 5V gate on that instrument's steps
